title: Alphabetically First Spin
statement:
Cutting a word at some point and swapping the two pieces gives a spin of the word; the word itself is also a spin. For example, the spins of `bca` are `bca`, `cab` and `abc`. Among all spins of the given word, find the one that comes first in alphabetical (dictionary) order.

## Input
One line containing the word `s`.

## Output
Print the alphabetically smallest spin of `s`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 100000`
- `s` contains only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
